faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: General information about orthodontics. Each treatment is evaluated individually during the consultation.

items.question: When should I have my first orthodontic consultation?
items.answer: An initial evaluation is useful as soon as the question comes up, regardless of age. The specialist will determine, case by case, the most suitable time to start treatment.

items.question: Can adults get orthodontic treatment?
items.answer: Yes, orthodontics for adults is common practice. The treatment plan is adapted to each patient's specific clinical situation, regardless of age.

items.question: Braces or aligners?
items.answer: The choice depends on the diagnosis, the complexity of the case, and the patient's preferences. The specialist will assess which option is most suitable during the consultation.

items.question: Does orthodontic treatment hurt?
items.answer: Some discomfort or sensitivity is common, especially in the first days after placement or certain adjustments. The team can advise on how to manage that sensitivity.

items.question: How long does treatment take?
items.answer: Duration varies depending on the diagnosis and complexity of each case. The specialist provides a personalized estimate during the initial evaluation, which may be adjusted during treatment.

items.question: How often are check-ups?
items.answer: The frequency of check-ups is set by the specialist based on the type of treatment and its progress. Keeping up with check-ups matters for the treatment's progress.

items.question: What happens after orthodontic treatment ends?
items.answer: A retention phase is usually recommended to help maintain the result achieved. The specialist will explain the recommended retention plan for each case.

items.question: Do I need any studies before starting?
items.answer: Depending on the diagnosis, the specialist may request additional studies (such as X-rays) to plan treatment appropriately.

items.question: How can I book a consultation?
items.answer: You can book a consultation by filling out the form on the Book page, or by messaging us directly on WhatsApp from any page on the site.
